dialogue.speaker: Boatkeeper
dialogue.text: We could not leave our homes, but we saved food for your company. Make sure that beacon means a safe tide.

intro.speaker: Mira
intro.text: Tomas's companions showed us the high bank through the woods. They will lead our land fighters. We take the lower wheel through the reeds.

intro.speaker: Captain Vale
intro.text: Senn says the council will hang deserters first. Your testimony will not save you.

intro.speaker: Mira
intro.text: He forged the council's order. Hear the clerk, or answer for holding this flood above the village.

intro.speaker: Edda
intro.text: Bring me to the beacon. I will signal only when both wheels are ours.

victory.speaker: Mira
victory.text: The tide is home. Tomas should have seen it.

victory.speaker: Edda
victory.text: Put someone from each shore beside each wheel. Keep this from happening again.
